slots.name: fields
slots.about: the answers to confirm, in order: id (1 up), label, value (text, may be empty), required (true or false)

slots.name: empty_line
slots.about: what an empty answer reads as

slots.name: missing_line
slots.about: after a create that can't go yet; may read missing (empty required answers), signed and open (the row being edited, 0 for none)

slots.name: edit
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: opens a row's editor (value: it.id), one row at a time

slots.name: set_draft
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: typing in the open row (value: the text)

slots.name: done_edit
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps the open row's text, trimmed

slots.name: cancel_edit
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: closes the open row without keeping

slots.name: toggle_sign
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: the consent checkbox

slots.name: create
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: creates once every required answer is filled, consent is given and no row is open; before that, says what is missing

empty.shows: an empty answer reads as the empty line and create is dimmed; after a try it turns to the destructive role

attention.shows: a line over create says what is missing, and an unticked box turns destructive

fallback.shows: create and every edit go away and a done line shows

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops smooth, swap and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: an empty answer reads as words, the circle has a tick when signed, and the missing line names what is left
